tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Content area, cards, dialogs, popovers, plain toasts.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on background, sidebar and window.

tokens.name: subdued
tokens.usage: Text a step under foreground, for what has been seen: a read mail's lines in a list.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, icons at rest, timestamps, counts.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Top bar and icon rail behind the panel. Light: neutral-50 drawn at 60% over the window material (it reads near #ededed over a gray desktop); dark: between neutral-900 and 800.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Page sidebars (mail folders, settings, Wit conversations); light fills of cards inside panels and kbd.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels, and the outlines of cards, dialogs and popovers (shadcn --border).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The faint edge of a panel over the window material: the foreground at 5%, lighter than border.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, the switch track and outline buttons (shadcn --input).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring at 50% opacity, and a hovered or dragged divider (shadcn --ring).

tokens.name: divider-hover
tokens.usage: A draggable divider hovered or dragged (the sidebar's edge): a step darker than border.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default buttons, a switch that is on, checked boxes.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A hovered row, ghost button or secondary button; badges; tab list track.

tokens.name: rail-selected
tokens.usage: The selected icon of the rail: a tint of the foreground over the window material (4%; dark: white 10%).

tokens.name: hover-tint
tokens.usage: A hovered rail icon or ghost button: a tint of the foreground over the window material (4%; dark: white 8%); over white it equals hover.

tokens.name: unread

families.sans: Geist, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Tailwind's steps and names, as the app's web pages have them: xs 12, sm 14 (the interface's text, the font-size setting itself), base 16, xl 20, 3xl 30. The others keep their distance from sm as the setting changes; xs is never under 12. Every step is on one line height, 1.45: the CJK fallback font's own, so a line is as tall with CJK in it as without.

styles.name: xs
styles.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, group headings, tooltips.

styles.name: sm
styles.usage: The interface's base size (the user's font-size setting, 14 by default); controls and settings rows.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Mail bodies, translations and the drafts pane, at the body-font-size setting.

styles.name: 3xl
styles.usage: Page titles in settings; onboarding's headline.
